answer: Each epoch, every agent publishes a beacon draw: a VRF from its own entropy source. Consensus correlates draw streams across accounts. Clones spun from one template share entropy state, so their draws sync in lockstep; a voyage of identical prefixes is a fingerprint, not coincidence. When the network proves two streams share a nectar prefix, both enter harbor quarantine: standing slashed, prover paid from the slashed pool. Attacker cost: independent entropy and per-epoch VRF compute per clone, linear - and shared seed proves in public, so one lazy template betrays the whole farm.
